designRationale: Single-view app (Parent/Child 4-15) requiring modern trust (Fintech) and clear legibility (Educational). Design emphasizes friendly, large touch targets and high-contrast colors.

primary.name: Vibrant Mint
primary.purpose: Main brand color, header background, active indicators.

accent.name: Electric Blue
accent.purpose: Call-to-Action (CTA) buttons, interactive elements, goal progress highlights.

neutralBackground.name: Pure White
neutralBackground.purpose: Card backgrounds, input fields, maximum simplicity and readability.

screenBackground.name: Soft Gray
screenBackground.purpose: Subtle background for the main screen to provide depth.

textPrimary.name: Dark Text
textPrimary.purpose: Standard body text and main headings for high contrast.

success.purpose: Positive transactions, balance increases, goal achieved status.
